entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add `nuget why` and `nuget package` command definitions #52661
  • Enable dotnet format to sort members #52656
  • False positive for CA2263 with codefix changing code functionality. #52654

Closed

  • GitHub Copilot Chat Assistant. What would you like me to do with that file/URL? Options I can do now — pick one: 1) Open and show the contents of IConfiguration.cs and explain its members. 2) Explain how IConfiguration relates to your HttpClient defaults snippet and how to use configuration there. 3) Find where AddServiceDiscovery() is defined (or show how to implement it). 4) Show commit/blame history for that file or the specific commit you linked. 5) Search the repo for usages of ConfigureHttpClientDefaults or AddServiceDiscovery. Tell me which option (or describe a different task) and I’ll proceed. #52645
  • ArtifactsPath-using projects break sourcelinking if the ArtifactsPath is outside of a known repo root. #52639
  • [NETSDKE2E]With 10.0.200-preview sdk zip, .NET workloads throw “Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WorkloadManifestReader.WorkloadManifestCompositionException” when run `dotnet --info`. #52478
  • Running `dotnet run file.cs` on empty file produces a misleading compiloation error #52644
  • `dotnet pack` for file-based apps fail determinism check #52614
  • dotnet run: -e|--environment help string could be confusing #50794

PullRequests

Created

  • Make the CLI able to be pointed at arbitrary toolchains #52665
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-CLI, cli-ux
  • `dotnet run -e FOO=BAR` passes `@(RuntimeEnvironmentVariable)` #52664
  • Don't ignore .e2e/ directories in gitignore template #52663
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52662
  • Remove predownload of packages that was originally a workaround #52660
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'release/10.0.2xx' #52657
  • [wasm] Use ProjectReference instead of PackageReference for HotReload tests #52655
    Area-WasmSdk, 11.0.1xx
  • Convert VisualStudioWorkloads to use direct COM #52650
  • Install `runtime`(s) with `dotnetup` #52649
  • File based programs #52648

Merged

  • Do not assume ordering between stdout and stderr in tests #52584
  • Update VersionFeature80 and VersionFeature90 values to the Jan values #52646
  • Add ArtifactsPath as SourceRoot with canonicalized path for source linking #52640
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Ignore trailing/leading whitespace when validating sarif files #52638
  • Add csc.rsp test #52510
    Area-Compilers, Test Debt
  • [release/10.0.3xx] backport mobile changes for `dotnet run` #52608
  • Update version numbers for features 80, 90, and 100 for Jan release #52496

Updated

  • Add `/newissue` command to create follow-up issues from PR comments #52620
  • Add `dotnetup env` command to generate shell environment configuration scripts #52641
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52632
  • [dotnet watch] Auto-restart when project does not support Hot Reload #52575
    Area-Infrastructure
  • dotnet root command and dotnet watch #52583
  • Added fixer for CA1848: Use the LoggerMessage delegates #52622
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52585
  • Add ExcludeFromCodeCoverage to template for MSTest, NUnit, XUnit #46866
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged, stale
  • sdk tasks migration to the ThreadSafe attribute, simple tasks, part 1 #52554
  • Refactor VSHostObject credential extraction for COM compatibility and out-of-process execution #52552
    Area-Containers
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.3xx' => 'main' #52519
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52596
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.2xx' => 'release/10.0.3xx' #52588
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix -extra container variant check to support .NET 9+ #52597
    Servicing-consider, Area-Containers
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Fix -extra container variant check to support .NET 9+ #52598
    Servicing-consider, Area-Containers
